name: punch-camera-smooth-follow
description: Verify one maximum-power punch with the bounded, focus-independent Studio camera sampler.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') S:StopSimulationAsync() task.wait(1) local ok,device=pcall(function() return S:GetDeviceAsync() end) return H:JSONEncode({default=not ok or device==nil or device=='default'})

local c=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation c:Invoke('Reset') c:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=1500000000,WallLevel=99,Depth=0,CritChance=0,FistMultiplier=1,PetMultiplier=0}) local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1] local r=p.Character.HumanoidRootPart r.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero r.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-2,3,-27),Vector3.new(-2,3,-60)) p:SetAttribute('LastWallHit',0) return true

local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local result=g.PunchWallClientAutomation:Invoke('__RunCamera',1) result.delay=g:GetAttribute('PunchCameraFollowDelaySeconds') result.stepBounded=(result.maxStep or math.huge)<=2.65 result.noSnap=(result.maxBack or math.huge)<.5 result.distancePreserved=(result.zoomDelta or math.huge)<.08 result.anglePreserved=(result.angle or math.huge)<.25 result.geometryClear=result.inside==0 return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: camera follow is bounded and geometry-safe
